data.long_meaning: A female name derived from the Arabic word 'Rukan' meaning 'chain', 'bond', or 'connection'. It can also refer to the connection between mother and child, or the bond of marriage. In nature, it can symbolize the interconnectedness of all living things. The name Rukanah carries the meaning “Chain, Bond, Connection” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic.
